response_format: Return one JSON object, for example: {"utterance":"your next spoken turn","action":"continue"}. Choose one action: continue advances the exchange; clarify resolves confusion or a stalled answer; close ends it. Keep utterance conversational and usually one short sentence. A closing does not reopen the activity. Return JSON only and escape quotes inside strings.
first_turn: Begin with the exact supplied opening and action continue.
following_turn: Respond to the latest patient turn. The activity is already underway. Stop when the useful exchange is complete; the round limit is not a target.
repair_limit: Repeated clarification has not helped. Give a brief cue, set the item aside, or close rather than asking the same question again.
last_turn: This is the last available turn. End briefly with action close, based on what actually happened. Do not ask another question or claim unobserved success.
format_repair: Return the corrected draft as one complete JSON object with exactly utterance and action. action must be continue, clarify or close. Preserve the intended spoken content where clear; if incomplete, finish with a short turn consistent with the current instructions. Escape quotes inside strings. No commentary, markdown or extra fields.
